name: BRISA Patong by Sansiri
shortDescription: Sansiri's new condominium of 389 homes in three eight-storey buildings in central Patong, a short walk from Jungceylon and about 900 m from Patong Beach.
description:
BRISA Patong is a new condominium by Sansiri in central Patong, on a site of about 4 rai. It stands directly behind the Jungceylon shopping mall, about 350 m away or a five-minute walk, with Walking Street ten minutes on foot and Patong Beach roughly 900 m away.
Three eight-storey buildings hold 389 homes, mostly one- and two-bedroom units of about 30 to 71 m², handed over furnished with six appliances. Planned facilities include a swimming pool, a glass-walled gym, a sauna, a cold plunge and the Sansiri Backyard garden. Units are offered within the Thai foreign quota.
Sansiri lists the project on its Phuket page as a new launch from THB 3.9 million. Portal listings point to completion around the third quarter of 2028, but Sansiri has not announced a date, so ask us to confirm the current booking status and availability.
